sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 language models, including pretrained and instruction-tuned models of 7 sizes, including 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct · Models
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.

sources.title: Visual Studio Code Local Assistant - docs.openvino.ai
sources.snippet: With the rise of AI PC capabilities, hosting own Visual Studio code assistant is at your reach. In this demo, we will showcase how to deploy local LLM serving with OVMS and integrate it with Continue extension.

sources.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 has demonstrated top-tier performance on a wide range of benchmarks eval-uating language understanding, reasoning, mathematics, coding, human preference alignment, etc. Specifically, the open-weight flagship Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct outperforms a number of open and proprietary models and demonstrates competitive performance to the state-of-the-art open-weight model, Llama-3-405B-Instruct ...
